title: Marvin Harrison Jr.: A lot of factors why it didn't work in Arizona, just looking forward now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Marvin Harrison Jr.: A lot of factors why it didn't work in Arizona, just looking forward now
sources.description: There was a lot of talk about Marvin Harrison Jr. being a can't miss prospect when he came out of Ohio State and the Cardinals were thrilled to take him fourth overall in 2024, but Harrison's time in Arizona did not play out as hoped.
